description: This Java class provides utility methods for creating, validating, and parsing JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) within a Spring application, primarily for security and authentication purposes.

classes.name: JwtTokenUtil
classes.description: A utility class for generating and validating JWT tokens, including access and refresh tokens, with support for claims and user details.

methods.name: JwtTokenUtil
methods.description: Constructor that initializes secret key, access token expiration time, and refresh token expiration time from configuration values, handling base64 decoding if necessary.

methods.name: generateAccessToken
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT access token with user details and optional extra claims, including roles and subject.

methods.name: generateRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT refresh token containing only the username and a token type claim.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Validates a token by comparing its embedded username with the provided UserDetails and checking expiration.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Extracts the username (subject) from a JWT token.

methods.name: isRefreshToken
methods.description: Checks if a token is a refresh token based on the 'typ' claim.

methods.name: isTokenExpired
methods.description: Determines if a token has expired based on its expiration claim.

methods.name: parseAllClaims
methods.description: Parses all claims from a JWT token, throwing JwtException if invalid.
